{
  "name_a": "Mostly snow-free terrain",
  "name_b": "Snow-covered terrain",
  "definition": "A patch lies closer to A when less of its land surface is covered by bright white to cyan snow and more exposed vegetation or brown ground is visible. B has extensive snow cover, often interrupted by dark wooded slopes.",
  "cues": [
    "B has widespread bright white areas in true color that remain white or cyan in false color; A largely lacks these.",
    "A shows extensive green or brown ground in true color, with vegetation often turning red in false color.",
    "B shows snow filling openings and forming bands along terrain, interspersed with dark vegetation."
  ],
  "visible": "high"
}
